name: PT-91 Twardy
protection: T-72M1 armour plus ERAWA-1/2 ERA (394 tiles) and steel side screens. Game: immune to all small-calibre rounds; 7.62x54R and 12.7/14.5 mm can only damage optics, external stowage, fuel drums and tracks (mobility kill on repeated hits); PG-7V/AT4/MAAWS/SMAW penetrate side, rear and turret roof; Javelin top-attack penetrates; frontal arc resists unguided launchers.
visual_notes: T-72 hull and turret (6 large road wheels, 3 return rollers) - hull 6.95 m, 9.67 m gun forward
Turret front and roof tiled almost gaplessly with flat rectangular ERAWA blocks in a neat chequer pattern
Steel side skirts (not rubber) carrying ERA blocks along the upper run
Two banks of 12 grenade dischargers on the turret sides
Polish three-tone or olive; Ukrainian PT-91s carry Ukrainian ID marks
